# vyos.blueprints.l3vpn

L3VPN control plane (docs blueprint "L3VPN for Hub-and-Spoke connectivity with VyOS")

- iBGP sessions carrying VPNv4 routes between PEs and route reflectors, using a peer-group, with `route-reflector-client` on RRs and `nexthop-self` on PEs.
- The PE VRFs (RD, route targets, `label vpn export`, CE neighbours) belong to `vyos.blueprints.vrf_lite`; the IGP to `vyos.blueprints.ospf`; label switching to `vyos.blueprints.mpls_ldp`.
- The BGP process (AS, router-id, cluster-id, neighbour logging) uses vyos.vyos.vyos_bgp_global; the peer-group and the VPNv4 neighbour options use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because the BGP modules cannot express them yet.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.l3vpn
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `l3vpn_asn` | int |  |  | Provider AS. Nothing is configured when unset. |
| `l3vpn_router_id` | str |  | `''` | BGP router-id (the loopback). |
| `l3vpn_cluster_id` | str |  | `''` | Route-reflector cluster-id (RRs only). |
| `l3vpn_log_neighbor_changes` | bool |  | `true` | Log neighbour changes. |
| `l3vpn_peer_group` | dict |  |  | Peer-group shared by the VPNv4 sessions. |
| `l3vpn_peer_group.name` | str | yes |  | Peer-group name, e.g. `RR_VPNv4`. |
| `l3vpn_peer_group.remote_as` | int | yes |  | Remote AS (the provider AS for iBGP). |
| `l3vpn_peer_group.update_source` | str |  |  | Source interface or address, e.g. `dum10`. |
| `l3vpn_neighbors` | list |  | `[]` | VPNv4 neighbours (RRs on a PE, PEs on an RR). |
| `l3vpn_neighbors.address` | str | yes |  | Neighbour loopback. |
| `l3vpn_neighbors.route_reflector_client` | bool |  | `false` | Treat as route-reflector client (on RRs). |
| `l3vpn_neighbors.nexthop_self` | bool |  | `false` | Set next-hop self for VPNv4 routes (on PEs). |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every VPNv4 session is established.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `l3vpn_neighbors` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
